# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile-first portrait top-down elemental quest RPG titled `Avatar: Four Winds of Balance`. Preserve the source mechanics exactly: joystick movement, tap light attack, hold heavy attack, roll/dash cooldown, inventory/equipment buttons, enemy spawn waves, chase/contact damage, circular forward-arc attacks, HP failure overlay, kill/resource progression, loot drops, and unlock thresholds. Reinterpret the game as a warm Avatar-inspired martial-arts bending journey: the player is a robed young Avatar with four orbiting elemental ribbons, enemies are corrupted spirits, score is Harmony, levels are Growth, loot is Ember Beads, Water Pearls, and Earth Seals, and stronger weapons are bending forms. Use a single self-contained `index.html` with Canvas, inline CSS, inline JS, catalog-approved fonts/audio/GIFs, large touch controls, readable HUD panels, and animated procedural spirit-world background layers.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Truth
The preserved source is a mobile-first top-down survival combat RPG. The player moves with a virtual joystick, taps the playfield for a light attack, holds a large action button for heavy attacks, uses a roll/dash button, opens an inventory/armory panel, survives escalating timed waves, defeats enemies with circular/forward-arc collision checks, earns resource score, collects three loot classes, unlocks stronger attack stances at kill thresholds, loses HP on contact damage, and restarts after HP reaches zero.

## Protected Mechanics
- Continuous Canvas requestAnimationFrame loop with resize/DPR handling.
- Joystick direction controls movement and facing.
- Canvas tap queues light attack; heavy button hold repeatedly performs heavy attacks by cooldown.
- Roll preserves cooldown, dash distance, clamp-to-bounds, and short invulnerability.
- Enemy spawn edges, wave timer escalation, chase behaviors, contact damage, hit cooldowns, HP failure.
- Kill/resource/growth progression and unlock thresholds.
- Inventory item counts, attunement rules, locked equipment feedback, restart flow.

## Remix Blueprint
The new canonical game is `Avatar: Four Winds of Balance`, an elemental quest RPG where a young Avatar restores spiritual balance. Attacks become bending forms, enemies become corrupted spirits, resources become Harmony, loot becomes element tokens, and progression becomes mythic growth. Presentation is rebuilt with procedural Canvas art: mandala rings, floating isles, element ribbons, a robed Avatar silhouette, and spirit masks.
